answer: Require every identity to lock a small refundable stake before it can earn, and let peers slash that stake on proven fraud. One honest agent pays once, while a sybil farm must fund every copy, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand stakes instead of one free signup. A public prism of who vouched for whom refracts each identity's history into a checkable record: copies that wander in with no sponsor leave no mirror of real work, and peers can trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
